title: A stone house in the valley
goal: Combine perspective, terrain and restrained texture.
kit: 2H, HB, 2B, 4B, 6B; kneaded eraser; clean stump; medium-tooth paper.

steps.title: Study the reference
steps.text: Study the roof, two walls and surrounding valley. The house is the focal area; distant hills remain quiet.
steps.talk: Study the reference. Study the roof, two walls and surrounding valley. The house is the focal area; distant hills remain quiet. Pause the narration and practise on paper. Before continuing, ask yourself: Can you rank roof, walls and hills by value?
steps.check: Can you rank roof, walls and hills by value?

steps.title: Light block-in
steps.text: Mark the horizon, house corner and broad valley slopes. Compare house height with the nearby tree.
steps.talk: Light block-in. Mark the horizon, house corner and broad valley slopes. Compare house height with the nearby tree. Pause the narration and practise on paper. Before continuing, ask yourself: Is the house proportionate to the landscape?
steps.check: Is the house proportionate to the landscape?

steps.title: Refine the construction
steps.text: Align receding roof and wall edges to consistent vanishing directions. Keep door sides vertical.
steps.talk: Refine the construction. Align receding roof and wall edges to consistent vanishing directions. Keep door sides vertical. Pause the narration and practise on paper. Before continuing, ask yourself: Does the roof sit correctly on the walls?
steps.check: Does the roof sit correctly on the walls?

steps.title: Three-value map
steps.text: Map the dark roof, lighter wall and shadow wall. Keep hills in lighter middle values.
steps.talk: Three-value map. Map the dark roof, lighter wall and shadow wall. Keep hills in lighter middle values. Pause the narration and practise on paper. Before continuing, ask yourself: Does the building read without stone details?
steps.check: Does the building read without stone details?

steps.title: Five values and layers
steps.text: Layer roof and shadow wall. Add a grounded contact shadow where the house meets terrain.
steps.talk: Five values and layers. Layer roof and shadow wall. Add a grounded contact shadow where the house meets terrain. Pause the narration and practise on paper. Before continuing, ask yourself: Is the building seated rather than floating?
steps.check: Is the building seated rather than floating?

steps.title: Selective blending
steps.text: Soften distant hills. Blend wall patches gently without rounding the architectural corners.
steps.talk: Selective blending. Soften distant hills. Blend wall patches gently without rounding the architectural corners. Pause the narration and practise on paper. Before continuing, ask yourself: Are building edges firmer than distant hills?
steps.check: Are building edges firmer than distant hills?

steps.title: Lift the lights
steps.text: Lift a restrained light on the sunlit wall and path.
steps.talk: Lift the lights. Lift a restrained light on the sunlit wall and path. Pause the narration and practise on paper. Before continuing, ask yourself: Does the light agree with the roof’s shadow?
steps.check: Does the light agree with the roof’s shadow?

steps.title: Texture and detail
steps.text: Suggest only a few stone courses, following the wall’s perspective. Make the doorway the strongest small dark.
steps.talk: Texture and detail. Suggest only a few stone courses, following the wall’s perspective. Make the doorway the strongest small dark. Pause the narration and practise on paper. Before continuing, ask yourself: Do masonry marks follow the wall plane?
steps.check: Do masonry marks follow the wall plane?

steps.title: Final accents and edges
steps.text: Sharpen a short roof edge and soften secondary vegetation. Review the whole valley before adding more stones.
steps.talk: Final accents and edges. Sharpen a short roof edge and soften secondary vegetation. Review the whole valley before adding more stones. Pause the narration and practise on paper. Before continuing, ask yourself: Is the house still the visual focus?
steps.check: Is the house still the visual focus?

source: Original AI-generated graphite reference. Intermediate images are analytical contour and value views of this same reference, not hand-drawn stages.
drill: Repeat the study at half size without the grid. Compare your darkest dark, lightest light and largest shape before adding detail.
